A '''treaded unipod''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Locomotor/Legends|locomotor]]<ref name="AEG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> that facilitated movement through the utilization of a single tread.<ref name="SWSaga">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars (Hasbro toy line)|packtype='04 Basic Figure|pack=#06: R1-G4 (Tatooine Transaction)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw0406r1-g4.asp}}</ref> The [[R1-series astromech droid/Legends|R1-series]], a model of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] that reused the frame of the [[Mark II reactor drone/Legends|Mark II reactor drone]], was equipped with a treaded unipod [[Limb/Legends|leg]].<ref name="AEG" /> However, the unipod was prone to breakdowns which often stranded the R1 unit in place.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
